business_problem: Bosch needed to reduce lengthy troubleshooting and documentation work after production-machine breakdowns so lines could restart faster without relying only on highly experienced specialists.
solution_summary: Bosch deployed its in-house Shopfloor Agent in the Bamberg manufacturing plant as an agentic AI assistant for shop-floor troubleshooting. The system is used on tablets by production associates and is designed to ingest machine error messages, operator context, and documentation from prior incidents that had previously been scattered across different drives or networks. The Shopfloor Agent uses its stored knowledge to analyze faults, classify the issue, develop problem-solving strategies, and return context-based resolution guidance in multiple languages, so operators can act even without deep technical expertise. Bosch states that the AI also documents and stores each error, its source, and the appropriate solution, creating a reusable knowledge base for future incidents. In practice, it serves production staff directly at the line to speed error analysis, shorten downtime, and make troubleshooting more consistent across plants.

solution_components.name: Shopfloor Agent
solution_components.role: Agentic AI software that analyzes machine errors, documents prior cases, and guides operators to faster fault resolution on the shop floor.

data_flow: Production-machine errors and operator observations are captured on tablets and combined with documentation and prior-case knowledge from Bosch's existing drives or networks. The Shopfloor Agent analyzes the fault context, classifies likely causes, retrieves relevant prior knowledge, and returns context-based solution guidance to production associates while storing the error, source, and resolution for reuse.

Prior incident documentation and error records
business_outcome: Bosch uses the Shopfloor Agent to restart production facilities faster after breakdowns, reduce costly downtime, preserve productivity in manufacturing, and capture troubleshooting knowledge so more operators can resolve issues without depending solely on veteran experts.
